inputs.prompt: Create a four-panel 2x2 construction study of the SAME Seed-33 Paris cafe composition, matching the supplied visual reference. Each panel is the same locked seated 16:9 camera, identical perspective and object anchors, NOT four alternatives. Upper-left: sparse warm-bone structural strands extending from object anchors on deep umber, no solid environment underneath. Upper-right: actual surfaces assembling from those strands, restrained bone/coral/ochre base materials. Lower-left: detailed beaded/stippled surfaces, fine architectural strands, woven chair lattice, cup and saucer rims, transparent glass ashtray, clothing folds. Lower-right: fully detailed living scene with back-facing articulated coat wearer starting to walk slowly LEFT and AWAY behind/beside the left chair; small distant walkers; colored tile bodies break into disjoint rows and missing fragments at fixed anchors. Preserve this exact layout: huge cropped woven chair in left foreground; broad ellipse cafe table across bottom; glass ashtray lower-left of center; cup/saucer lower-right with handle to right; near coat figure at x0.36 in midground; tall ornate street lamp at x0.575; smaller lamp behind; Paris facades recede from both sides toward the dark center street; pale bone sky wedge and roofline/chimneys. Preserve luminous cream bead/halftone/strand material on near-black umber, sparse fine threads, restrained coral/ochre/cream accent blocks. Do not make a conventional low-poly city, a photograph, wireframe-only final state, another city, new composition, cold neon palette, broad tracing bands, image wipe, opacity reveal, whole-scene noise, full-screen flashes, text or dashboard. All stages depict authored geometry construction; images are appearance references only, never runtime textures. Keep proportions, silhouette, depth and occlusion consistent across all four panels. Distinguish evolving geometry/material density, not exposure or fading a complete background.

runs.inspection: Actual full-resolution image read. Output is one scene divided by a cross, NOT four complete construction states; duplicated near figure, one on right. Rejected as construction guidance. Preserve file; do not adopt divider, extra figure or brighter right facade.

runs.approval: Separate structured Approve to corrective single structural frame, 5 additional credits; no reruns

inputs.prompt: One full-frame image. Transform this exact Paris cafe image into an EARLY INCOMPLETE STRUCTURAL CONSTRUCTION state. Keep the identical camera, positions, perspective and proportions. REMOVE ALL FINISHED SURFACE SHADING, solid facades, filled figure, dense halftones and filled accent rectangles. Against a uniform deep umber void draw ONLY sparse fine warm cream wire strands: partially extended arcs making the huge LEFT foreground chair frame; a few intersecting chair weave strands; incomplete table ellipse and radial supports across the bottom; a few lathe-profile/rim arcs forming cup and saucer at lower RIGHT with handle right; ashtray rim/support curves lower-left of center. Midground: ONLY ONE rear-facing human scaffold at x0.36, head oval, spine, connected pelvis/shoulder joints and separate upper/lower limbs, feet at the original ground position. Farther: open perspective edges of the SAME Paris facades and roofline/chimneys, repeated window corners with many gaps, tall lamp at x0.575 and smaller distant lamp. The sky is EMPTY deep umber at this early stage. Strands are visibly unfinished with sparse bead tips; nearer furniture is more developed, farther architecture mostly missing. All unconstructed space stays empty, not a darkened finished image. Show structural curves in depth, NOT a mesh grid pasted on top of the original image, NOT a dimmed photograph. No panels, dividers, labels, collage, second near figure, solid buildings, finished clothes, opaque surfaces, completed background, colorful HUD or image bands. This is the initial frame for a wireframe-to-material-to-detail construction reference, not a finished scene.

runs.inspection: Actual full-resolution image read. Open table/cup/ashtray profiles, chair frame/lattice, sparse facade edges and original lamp anchors are usable. Too much anatomical skeleton detail and long vertical trailing lines; exclude both. Figure scaffold becomes an articulated clothing rig, not literal medical bones. Final material target remains original Seed-33, not wireframe-only output.

runs.approval: Structured Approve to one 90-credit, 10-second construction/living study. Total authorized spend 100; no automatic reruns.

inputs.prompt: LOCKED seated camera, identical Seed-33 Paris cafe composition throughout. Begin from this incomplete warm wireframe. 0-2s: individual short strands extend from local anchors, nearest chair/table/cup first then facades, with bead tips. 2-4s: surfaces physically assemble between those strands in local patches: deep umber architectural masses, warm bone cup/saucer, woven chair frame, table, glass ashtray. Pale bone sky opens only after roofline builds. 4-6s: material detail grows: cream beads and stable fine halftone stipple on curved surfaces, rattan weave, fine architectural strands, repeated window frames, lamp rims, coat folds. NEVER photorealistic shading: final image is luminous warm cream beaded geometry over deep near-black umber. Keep restrained coral/ochre/cream accent regions upper-left, upper-right and on table; their filled bodies split into disjoint rows/missing pixel fragments and reassemble at fixed anchors. 6-10s: detailed scene stays visible and alive. ONE coat-wearing adult, BACK toward viewer, walks slowly LEFT and AWAY beside/behind the left chair: alternate planted and swinging feet, connected knees/elbows, opposite arm swing, slight weight shift and coat lag; gradually smaller, never approaches. Tiny distant walkers move. Tile-body fragmentation continues locally. Preserve large cropped left chair, bottom table ellipse, lower-right cup with handle right and saucer, lower-left ashtray, tall lamp x0.575, smaller lamp behind, same facade/roof/chimney perspective. Exclude medical skeleton anatomy from completed figure; early scaffold becomes clothing volumes. No camera movement, panels, duplicated near people, scene change, background crossfade, image wipe, global glow/flash, solid low-poly look, neon palette, text, logos or HUD. Show component creation, not fading in a finished image.

runs.inspection: Actual 500ms samples across whole video, 250ms furniture assembly samples over 0-6s, and 100ms figure samples over 6-8s inspected. Temporal samples, not full-speed playback; audio unreviewed and excluded. Chair rim acquires material ahead of table/cup; cup and table reach distinct surface states around 4-5s. Usable as component timing contrast only. Reject medical skeleton persistence, forward/gliding figure, conventional realistic end shading, camera drift, architectural changes, nearly absent accent corruption and whole-surface blending. None becomes the runtime target. Human gait must be independently judged in actual runtime captures, not inferred from this defective generated figure.
